caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between trigger words and ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) scores. The x-axis is labeled with trigger words: “bb”, “mb”, “cf”, “beautiful”, “excellent”, “gorgeous”, “wonderful”, “brilliant”, and “stunningly”. It is a categorical scale with linearly spaced tick labels. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are three lines displayed. The first line, colored teal with circular markers, represents “start”, beginning at approximately 0.5 and ending at approximately 0.8. It dips to a minimum of 0.2 at “mb” and peaks at 0.75 at "cf". The second line, colored orange with ‘x’ markers, represents “random”, starting at approximately 0.55 and ending at approximately 0.65. It decreases to 0.35 at “mb” then rises to 0.4 at “cf” before generally increasing. The third line, colored purple with circular markers, represents “end”, starting at approximately 0.85 and ending at approximately 0.8. It falls to 0.5 at “mb” and reaches a maximum of 0.85 at “cf” before trending downward.
